hook_rules: Promise the number and the payoff in the first line ('3 things that…'). Make item 1 the strongest so the viewer stays for the rest.
connector_rule: Within items 'and then' is acceptable for the list itself, BUT each item's why-line still needs a BUT or THEREFORE. Open a loop before item 1 ('the last one surprised me').
last_dab: End on which item to start with today, phrased as a line worth repeating — not 'follow for more'.

beats.purpose: promise the list and why it matters, name the count
one list item: claim then one-line why
which item to start with today + follow for more
